items.computation: Invoice date (document_date) is Tue 13.05.2025. Sender is a private company, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs from the invoice date itself as stated ('ab Rechnungsdatum'). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (13.05.2025) is not counted, so counting starts 14.05.2025. Adding 21 days (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on Tue 03.06.2025. That day is a normal working day (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW), so under § 193 BGB no shift is needed. Due date: 03.06.2025.
